factorial.design: 2 memory (deterministic ledger, frozen ArbiterKB) x 2 policy (generic, task-matched)
factorial.common_state_schema: demonstration target plus execution-only semantic action counts
factorial.episode_selection: lexicographically first three validation indices [0,1,2]; all validation indices were previously used, so this is an exploratory reuse, not fresh validation

validation_analysis_plan.primary_effect: paired success risk difference arbiter_matched minus ledger_matched, pooled over six task-episode blocks
validation_analysis_plan.uncertainty: Wilson intervals per arm; deterministic 10000-draw paired cluster bootstrap intervals for effects
validation_analysis_plan.tests: two-sided exact paired McNemar for the four frozen pairwise contrasts
validation_analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across four pooled pairwise contrasts; task-level n=3 is descriptive only
validation_analysis_plan.interaction: paired block contrast (D-C)-(B-A), bootstrap interval, descriptive
validation_analysis_plan.reruns: none within this frozen run; every timeout, failure, and infrastructure error is preserved
validation_analysis_plan.go_gate: all 24 cells have protocol-compliant terminal status, no systematic harness error, exact model, matched reset/seed/executor settings, and total recorded cost below stop
validation_analysis_plan.interpretation: exploratory pilot only because episodes 0-2 were used in prior common-harness work; no held-out claim
